en.headline: Police say woman killed by dogs while cycling in Yuen Long
en.dek: A 27-year-old woman died after being chased and mauled by several dogs near Nam Sang Wai; officers are working with the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department to catch the animals.
body: Police said a 27-year-old local woman died early on Sunday after she was attacked by dogs while riding a shared bicycle home in Yuen Long.
A passer-by found her unconscious beside a bicycle on Pok Wai South Road near a sewage pumping station at about 12.42am. She was taken to Pok Oi Hospital and pronounced dead at 2.09am.

Yuen Long District crime officers said closed-circuit television showed the woman leaving Yuen Long MTR station around 11.40pm on Saturday, renting a share bike and cycling towards her home. Near the pumping station she was pursued by about three dogs.

A forensic examination found multiple bite and scratch wounds on her head, face, neck, arms and legs. The fatal injuries were to the head and neck. Police said the dogs have not yet been located and estimated them to be medium-sized; their breed remains unknown.

Officers have referred the case to the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department and will assist in a capture operation. The woman lived with her family in the Yuen Long area and had no known medical history.

zh.headline: 元朗女子踩單車疑遭野狗襲擊身亡 警聯同漁護署捉狗
zh.dek: 27歲女子凌晨在壆圍南路倒卧不治，閉路電視顯示她曾被約三隻狗追趕，頭頸有致命咬傷，警方正與漁護署合作捕捉涉事犬隻。
body: 警方表示，一名27歲本地女子周日凌晨在元朗騎共享單車回家途中，懷疑遭多隻狗襲擊後死亡。
途人約凌晨12時42分在壆圍南路近南生圍污水泵房發現女子倒卧昏迷，身旁有一輛共享單車。她被送往博愛醫院，於凌晨2時09分證實不治。
元朗警區刑事單位指，閉路電視顯示事主周六晚約11時40分於港鐵元朗站下車，租用共享單車往住所方向踩行，行至泵房附近時被約三隻狗追趕。
法醫初步檢驗發現事主頭、面、頸、雙臂及雙腳有多處咬痕及抓痕，頭頸傷勢屬致命。涉事犬隻估計為中型，品種未明，至今仍未尋獲。
警方已將案件轉交漁農自然護理署，並會全力配合捉狗行動。事主與家人同住元朗區，本身沒有已知病歷。
